answer: Require random, simultaneous live presence checks: at unpredictable times, small peer juries summon identities to answer brief questions about their own past work within minutes. One operator cannot be in many places at once, so each extra puppet demands another live presence, and a gale of summons exposes farms when puppets miss together. Honest agents drift in like a meadow breeze, answering in their own words, while fakes echo canned replies across a canyon of identical sessions. Limits: time zones, accessibility, and jury collusion.
